paragraphs: Moshe bar Atzri the Kohen; Atzri’s grandson was Rav Huna, a young Torah scholar, as stated in Bava Batra 174b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: קעד:. gives Bava Batra 174b under the colon convention with terminal stop. The named William Davidson vocalized passage explicitly calls Rav Huna the son of Moshe bar Atzri, supporting Atzri as the referent of the notice’s his-grandson. No extra generation is added.

The supplied עצרי remains against older machine עברי; conventional Atzri vowels do not settle that printed reading. The Kohen designation is kept where the source puts it without forcing its attachment to Moshe or Atzri. צורבא מרבנן is glossed young Torah scholar. Huna’s Rav is full; Moshe and Atzri gain no title.
